sloka: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी लक्ष्मणं रावणार्दितम् ।अनयद्राघवाभ्याशं बाहुभ्यां परिगृह्य तम् ।। ६.५९.११९ ।।।।
transliteration: hanumānapi tejasvī lakṣmaṇaṁ rāvaṇārditam ।anayadrāghavābhyāśaṁ bāhubhyāṁ parigṛhya tam ।। 6.59.119 ।।।।

translations.english: Brilliant Hanuman holding Lakshmana wounded by Ravana in both shoulders brought him to Rama.
